q2: SELECT NAME FROM SALESPERSON WHERE SALES_ID NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT SALES_ID FROM ORDERS LEFT JOIN COMPANY ON COMPANY.COM_ID = ORDERS.COM_ID WHERE COMPANY.NAME = 'RED' )
